content.title: Nidec Secures $3.9 Billion Credit Line, Easing Liquidity Fears
content.summary: Nidec’s stock rose as much as 5% early Wednesday.  Nidec’s shares and bonds had come under pressure after the company found evidence in September that senior executives may have been involved in a number of accounting issues at subsidiaries.  “This commitment line agreement should ease equity market concerns about Nidec’s liquidity,” Citigroup analyst Takayuki Naito wrote in a note.
